title: Long-run health and backpressure evidence
summary: Added read-only long-run reliability evidence to runtime counters, autonomy health, diagnostics payloads, and Home/Diagnostics UI surfaces.
reason: A 30-day unattended run needs blocked health evidence for stalled rounds, stale pause flags, pending-publish backlog, stale worker slots, and state DB maintenance before those conditions silently accumulate.
behavior_before: Runtime health exposed only the prior reliability counters and did not classify the new long-run blocker conditions requested for unattended operation.
behavior_after: Runtime health carries additive reliability fields and autonomy health emits review/blocker codes without adding frontend-owned mutation or policy decisions.
rollback_plan: Revert the additive runtime health/autonomy health/UI evidence changes and remove the matching tests and inventory notes; no persisted media state migration is required.
notes: Additive long-run runtime reliability counters and autonomy health evidence.
